Reference behavior: Same link receives edited snapshot; copied-file location warning.
Acceptance check: Update a disposable share and verify browser reload and wrong-copy warning.

Reference behavior: Upload/download failures offer retry and incomplete-state guidance.
Acceptance check: Interrupt a controlled transfer; retry without publishing an unexpected document.

Reference behavior: Confirmed link deletion; ZIP download is an independent copy.
Acceptance check: Revoke disposable link; verify inaccessible link and intact prior download.

Reference behavior: Post a named canvas comment and reply from a shared design.
Acceptance check: Verify marker/target identity, delivery, reload and failed-post handling.

Reference behavior: Upload bounded image attachments before submitting feedback.
Acceptance check: Check type/count/size/dimension limits, upload cancellation and retry.

Reference behavior: Refresh/filter markers, resolve/reopen threads and identify deleted targets.
Acceptance check: Verify owner/reviewer authority and persisted thread state with disposable shares.

Reference behavior: Visible top-level frames; draggable thumbnail ordering.
Acceptance check: Compare hidden/nested frames, selection and persisted order.

Reference behavior: Start from selected slide; arrows/Space/Enter advance; Escape returns.
Acceptance check: Run native presentation, compare active slide and focus when returning.

Reference behavior: All/selected slides; slide order and individual frame dimensions.
Acceptance check: Open actual PDF; inspect pages, order, sizes and selected-only errors.
